answer: Each identity erects a jetty arch anchored by its own living vine. An independent surveyor signs a sonnet whose stanzas commit to every earlier arch, and the ledger accepts it only after the new span is measured. The first arch spans one unit; each later arch must equal the total span of all earlier arches. Thus k identities require 1+2+4+...+2^(k-1) = 2^k-1 units of permanent pier. Crews may be shared, but one certified arch cannot admit two names.
